newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-GREMIO WIN BRAZIL TITLE WITH LATE GOAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GREMIO WIN BRAZIL TITLE WITH LATE GOAL.

text.p: Gremio won the Brazilian championship in dramatic circumstances on Sunday, scoring the goal that decided the title five minutes from the end of the final against underdogs Portuguesa.
Substitute Ailton hammered in a rebound in the 85th minute to give Gremio a 2-0 win at home in the second leg of the final.
Portuguesa had won the first leg 2-0 but, with the aggregate score level, Gremio took the title on having the better overall record in the competition.
Sunday's game was marred by more than 70 fouls but Marcio Resende de Freitas, the astonishingly lenient referee, handed out only three yellow cards.
The win was a reward for the brute strength of Gremio, whose physical style has won them few admirers, over the finesse of Portuguesa.
Gremio last year won the South American Libertadores Cup playing with the same dour tactics.

Portuguesa, a small club from Sao Paulo who best previous performance in the competition was a modest seventh place, surprised everyone by reaching the final and striker Rodrigo was the revelation of the championship.

Gremio, who are based in the southern city of Porto Alegre, reduced the first leg deficit after just three minutes when Paulo Nunes scored his 17th goal of the championship, making him the competition's top scorer.
Portuguesa survived an aerial bombardment for the rest of the first half but created several chances of their own on the counter-attack.

They appeared to have survived everything Gremio could throw at them until the fateful moment in the 85th minute when the defence failed to clear the ball properly and Ailton blasted in a rebound from 15 metres.
At the end, several Gremio players collapsed and wept uncontrollably amid hysterical scenes.
It was the club's second national title, the previous coming in 1981.

Gremio - 1-Danrlei, 2-Francisco Arce, 3-Catalino Rivarola (Luciano, 65th minute), 4-Mauro Galvao, 6-Roger, 5-Dinho (15- Ailton, 75th), 8-Luis Carlos Goiano, 10-Emerson, 11-Carlos Miguel, 7-Paulo Nunes, 9-Ze Alcino.
Portuguesa - 1-Clemer, 2-Valmir, 3-Emerson, 4-Cesar, 6- Carlos Roberto (16-Tico, 80th), 5-Capitao, 8-Gallo, 9-Caio, 11- Ze Roberto, 10-Rodrigo, 7-Alex Alves.
